about: The ground-truth suite's fixture set (validation_ground_truth_note, 'The fixture set'; TASK-M3-24): each start, its tier, its entry path, its source and the quantities asserted on it, with each criterion. Read by crates/validation/tests/ground_truth.rs (ground_truth_fixture_set), which holds the set to at least one fixture per tier and to the note's table. Times are canonical (G = 1, M = 1, I = 1) unless a unit is named. 'phys' is inverse_encode_contract Part 4's norm (validation::roundtrip::phys). Built from the contract and the papers cited, not transcribed from prin-rs.

fixtures.name: conservation_figure_eight
fixtures.source: Noether: E, L_z and P are constants of the motion; the run is figure_eight's
fixtures.construction: figure_eight's march, read at its end: E by the RK45 reference's own formula, L_z and P summed here, never from the stored f16 latches
asserted: ‖ΣP − ΣP0‖ / max‖p_i‖ ≤ 1e-11

fixtures.name: lagrange_equilateral
fixtures.source: Lagrange 1772: the equilateral relative equilibrium, any masses, ω² = GM/a³ (dd_validation_orbits §1.3)
fixtures.construction: masses (0.2, 0.3, 0.5), side a = β^(−1/2) with β = m0m1 + m0m2 + m1m2 so I = 1, centre of mass at the origin, p_i = m_i ω ẑ × r_i; Yoshida-4, the default links, r_coll = 1e-3, half a turn, the macro-step landing on it
asserted: CHECK 1: not clamped, residual ≤ ε_phys (REQ-ENC-024's register value at f64)
the pixel's decode equals CHECK 1's D(z) bit for bit
CHECK 2: phys(closed form at T, march at T) ≤ 1e-8

fixtures.name: euler_collinear
fixtures.source: Euler 1767: the collinear relative equilibrium; at equal masses, the outer bodies at ∓a, ω² = 5m/(4a³) (dd_validation_orbits §1.3)
fixtures.construction: equal masses 1/3, the middle body labelled 2 at the origin (λ̃ = 0, the α = 0 pole), a = √(3/2) so I = 1, p_i = m_i ω ẑ × r_i; Yoshida-4, r_coll = 1e-3, half a turn, the macro-step landing on it
asserted: the encode clamps it (lookup_clamped): it is Path B's
phys(closed form at T, march at T) ≤ 1e-8
the shape point at T is the Euler point E2, (1, 0, 0), each component within 1e-8
a start off the gauge is refused

fixtures.name: figure_eight
fixtures.construction: relabelled so the middle body is in the inner pair (bodies (x1, 0, −x1), velocities (v1, v3, v2)): the published labelling is on the α = 0 pole; to G = 1, Σm = 1 (velocities /√3), canonicalised; the period T8·√3·λ^(3/2); Yoshida-4, the default links, r_coll = 1e-3, the macro-step landing on the period
asserted: CHECK 1: not clamped, residual ≤ ε_phys
the pixel's decode equals CHECK 1's D(z) bit for bit
CHECK 2, closure: phys(D(z), march at the period) ≤ 1e-6 (the RK45 reference's own closure, from the published digits, is 4.1e-8)
CHECK 2: phys(RK45 at the period, march at the period) ≤ 1e-8
reported: the published labelling's residual, κ and clamp

fixtures.name: burrau
fixtures.source: Burrau 1913; Szebehely & Peters 1967, AJ 72, 876: masses (3, 4, 5) at rest at (1, 3), (−2, −1), (1, −1), G = 1; the lightest body escapes and the other two form a binary, disruption near t ≈ 60 in their units (dd_validation_orbits §1.5)
fixtures.construction: to G = 1, Σm = 1, canonicalised; one of their time units is √12·5^(−3/4) = 1.0360 canonical; Heggie × RK4 at the field backend's values, the default links, r_coll = 0 (BENCHMARK_R_COLL), to 100 of their time units
asserted: CHECK 1: not clamped, residual ≤ ε_phys
CHECK 2: the march ends in escape, its escaper the lightest body (body 0 here)
CHECK 2: the escape fires between 50 and 100 of their time units
the RK45 reference at the horizon has the same escaper, read structurally (two-body energy positive, ten pair separations away)
the run's provenance carries r_coll = BENCHMARK_R_COLL

the march and the RK45 reference leave the lightest body unbound (its two-body energy about the other two positive at every later sample, sampled every 0.5 of their units from 50 to 70, then every 5 to 100) from a time in [60, 65] of their units, and it has escaped at 100 (entry_paths_burrau_ejects_on_time; the two label criteria above are ignored until TASK-M3-34)
reported: the escape's time in their units
the march's least separation d_min against the default r_coll = 1e-3
